== Biography ==
Jane was born in 1819. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-539|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Miller-37219|Margaret Miller]].  She passed away in 1859. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The held profile explicitly attributes Hugh and Margaret Miller, but 1850 has no relationship column and no separate natal record is reproduced.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.
